Headline: #34 South Michigan Temporary Reroute at Michigan/120th
ShortDescription: 34 South Michigan buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near Michigan/120th.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#34 South Michigan buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Michigan, 119th, State, 122nd, Michigan then resume their normal route, due to street blockage near Michigan/120th.

Allow extra travel time.
